name: SpectreMail side-panel probe
description: Throwaway fixture, not the product. Declares `sidePanel` so `chrome.sidePanel` exists at all, `storage` so a panel's report outlives the document that wrote it, a content script so the `sendMessage` arm has a page to reach, and the two provider origins because one arm asks whether an extension-hosted page can reach a provider directly. It deliberately does NOT declare `tabs` - that is the whole point of the `tabs` variant, and declaring it here would make the two routes indistinguishable. The three scripts that run in a document live in `documents/` rather than beside the service worker, because this fixture spans three contexts and `eslint.config.js` gives a file one: keeping them apart is what lets both environments be declared exactly instead of their union being declared for everything. Ships no user-facing surface, and no product manifest may copy `sidePanel` or `tabs` from here: the instrument that answers a question may need rights the product does not have yet.
